basic_details.job_title: IIIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Ph.D, Postdoctoral Fellowship Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Information Technology Dharwad (IIIT Dharwad) has announced 3 vacancies for Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) Full-time, Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) Part-time, and Postdoctoral Fellowship (PDF) posts under its 2026 recruitment. Qualifications and pay vary by post, with full-time Ph.D. fellowship at Rs. 46,250/month for Years 1-2 and Rs. 52,500/month for Years 3-5, and the Postdoctoral Fellowship at Rs. 1,08,393/month including HRA, subject to availability of funds from the funding agency. The tenure is up to 5 years or until completion for Ph.D. and up to 1 year for PDF. Eligib

how_to_apply: Access the appropriate online application form based on your applied position via the Institute's Google Form links.
Fill out the Rolling Ph.D. Advertisement Google Form and select the appropriate Ph.D. option for Ph.D. applicants.
Submit the prescribed PDF application form for Postdoctoral Fellowship applicants.
Ensure application submission is completed on or before 31 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Ph.D. and Postdoctoral Fellowship positions must meet the specific educational, academic, and employment criteria outlined for each program. rows.essential_qualification: M.E./M.Tech./MCA/M.Sc. or equivalent in relevant disciplines with valid GATE/NET score or qualification through a national-level selection process conducted by IIIT Dharwad or other recognized examination. Minimum CGPA/CPI of 6.0 (General/OBC/EWS) or 5.5 (SC/ST/PwD), OR minimum 60% marks (General/OBC/EWS) or 55% marks (SC/ST/PwD) in aggregate. B.E./B.Tech./MCA degree holders may also be considered for direct Ph.D. Part-time candidates must be employed professionals in industry, R&D, or academia and submit an NOC.
Hold a Ph.D. in a relevant discipline and be 40 years of age or below.
rows.desirable: Strong research credentials demonstrated through quality publications and/or patents.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Full-time Ph.D. scholars receive a fellowship of Rs. 46,250 per month for Years 1–2 and Rs. 52,500 per month for Years 3–5, along with 16% HRA, for a maximum duration of 5 years or until completion of Ph.D., whichever is earlier. Part-time Ph.D. candidates receive no fellowship under the scheme and must be self-supported or supported by their employer. Postdoctoral Fellows receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 1,08,393 per month (including HRA) for up to 1 year, plus Rs. 1,00,000 annual contingency support and Rs. 2.10 lakh travel support as applicable under the scheme. All financial support is subject to fund availability from the funding agency, scheme guidelines, and satisfactory performance. Selected candidates cannot simultaneously receive funding from any other Government of India or State Government scheme.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The institute shortlists candidates based on academic qualifications, research credentials, experience, and other relevant criteria. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through email regarding the selection process, which includes the test and/or interview schedule as applicable. Final admission and selection decisions rest with the Competent Authority of IIIT Dharwad.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIIT Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for Ph.D. and Postdoctoral Fellowship positions is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What financial support is provided for Full-time Ph.D. scholars under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme?
faq.answer: Full-time Ph.D. scholars receive Rs. 46,250 per month for Years 1–2 and Rs. 52,500 per month for Years 3–5, along with 16% HRA, subject to fund availability.

faq.question: Q3. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the Postdoctoral Fellowship pay?
faq.answer: The Postdoctoral Fellowship pays a consolidated amount of Rs. 1,08,393 per month, which includes HRA, along with Rs. 1,00,000 annual contingency support and Rs. 2.10 lakh travel support.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for age relaxation or category concessions?
faq.answer: Category concessions apply to CGPA and aggregate marks, lowering the minimum requirement from 6.0 CGPA / 60% for General/OBC/EWS candidates to 5.5 CGPA / 55% for SC/ST/PwD candidates. Reservation applies as per Government of India norms.
